rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A cross-platform browser history server that provides secure access to browsing data from Brave, Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Arc, Opera, and DuckDuckGo browsers across Windows, macOS, and Linux. The implementation handles browser-specific database schemas and timestamp formats, creates temporary database copies to avoid locking issues, and includes specialized decryption support for DuckDuckGo's ChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted history on macOS using keychain integration. It exposes three tools for searching history by terms, retrieving recent entries, and finding most visited sites, making it useful for personal productivity analysis, research assistance, and building AI assistants that can reference your browsing context.
